mechanism: Zoledronic acid causes nephrotoxicity and can impair renal clearance of atazanavir and its metabolites, while atazanavir may increase zoledronic acid exposure through altered renal handling.
action: Monitor renal function closely (eGFR, serum creatinine) before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; consider dose adjustments or increased dosing intervals if renal function declines.
